title: Warn when stock is low
description: Warehouse staff want a warning when a SKU is running low so they can reorder before it sells out. The threshold should probably be configurable, and someone needs to be notified.
acceptance_criteria:
- A warning is shown for low stock
- The threshold can be changed
- Someone is notified

title: Let users delete their account
description: We need to support account deletion for privacy reasons. When a user deletes their account their data should be removed. Orders may need to be kept for accounting.
acceptance_criteria:
- User can request deletion from settings
- Account is deleted
- User receives confirmation
